meta.title: Worktrees
meta.description: Choose a Git branch or a new local worktree for each conversation, with recoverable background cleanup.

ui.noGit: This workspace is not a Git repository.
ui.noCommit: Create a commit in this repository before creating a worktree.
ui.gitUnavailable: Git is unavailable. Local sessions can still use this workspace.
ui.locked: This session will continue in its prepared directory.
ui.snapshotHelp: Git-ignored files are not included. Restored changes are recorded in a snapshot commit.
ui.localHint: Use the source directory. Choosing a branch checks it out immediately.
ui.newHint: Create a local worktree when the first message is sent.
ui.baseHint: Choose the base branch for the new worktree.
ui.directoryHelp: Applies to newly created worktrees. Existing worktrees keep their paths.
ui.retentionHelp: Eligible worktrees above this limit are snapshotted before cleanup. Pinned sessions and active work are protected, so the total can exceed the limit.
ui.invalidMaximum: Enter a whole number of at least 1.
ui.restoreBody: This worktree has been cleaned up. Restore its saved snapshot to continue in a detached worktree.
ui.deleteBody: This removes the worktree directory and archives its associated chats. A saved snapshot remains available for restoration.
ui.deleteProtected: Active worktrees and worktrees with pinned sessions cannot be deleted.
ui.archivedHelp: Unarchive this session in the sidebar to open it.
ui.invalidResponse: The worktree service returned an invalid response.
ui.notReady: The worktree is not ready. Refresh and try again.
ui.adapterUnavailable: This DSH version does not expose the supported conversation send method.
